entities.name: Horia Demian
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Horia Demian was a Romanian basketball player who played for Universitatea Cluj from 1960 until 1970. During that period, U Cluj finished second in one season and third in four seasons in the Romanian Basketball Division A.
